tldr: Lilith in Gemini: the unspoken and the silenced voice
body: Lilith in Gemini: the unspoken and the silenced voice. Where you reclaim the right to say the forbidden thing. Watch: provocation for its own sake. Unfiltered speech and thought: you refuse to be silenced, censored, or talked over. A communication wound: honesty that got punished early, being told to be quiet, truths that stirred conflict. It reads people sharply and refuses to lie. The growth is learning to deliver the truth with a tone soft enough for it to land, often finding its real outlet in writing.
business: Owned, this is a sharp, truthful voice that says what others won't.
shadow: Suppressed it becomes self-censorship; unchecked, a cutting or manipulative tongue.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
note: Imported from approved project Black Moon Lilith material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
